_comment: Machine-readable record of the owner's real product fixture authorization. This file is the ENFORCEMENT POINT for the authorization's own scope clause -- 'Authorization applies only to the exact files listed in this document'. tools/validate-authorized-assets.js refuses any asset not named here, so the scope limit is a mechanical check rather than a promise. Adding a filename here without a corresponding owner authorization is exactly the failure this file exists to prevent.

authorization.scopeClause: Authorization applies only to the exact files listed in this document.
notPermitted: adding unrelated retailer/catalog images not listed above

assets.note: Expected to carry text/logo/directional pattern -- the mirroring, cropping, orientation and stretch canary. Shot class to be confirmed on delivery.

_note_on_directory: Authorized product imagery is delivered into fixtures/products/ and is TRACKED deliberately (like fixtures/garments/), not ignored. It is isolated-development-only and must never be bundled into a production build -- see docs/fixture-consent-log.md.
_note_on_format: All seven authorized assets are named .jpg. packages/static-renderer implements a pure-Node PNG codec and has NO JPEG decoder, and tests/privacy/dependencyBoundary.test.js pins the external-runtime-dependency allow-list to empty. Ingestion therefore requires either lossless PNG/TIFF delivery of the same seven images, or a reviewed decision to add a JPEG decoding capability. See docs/fixture-consent-log.md.
